oh_orientation_diagnostic.purpose: Post-inference sensitivity diagnostic only. Uniform six-angle OH torsion grid; fixed heavy atoms; no receptor-conditioned minimization or selection. Ligand-only MMFF energy is not protein binding energy. No modified coordinates fed to engine or workspace.

sources.supports: Retrospective NU6102 complex and Asp86 interaction context.
United-atom scoring and hydrogen-position/protonation caveats; approximate docking.
Explicit-H and preparation dependence of contact fingerprints.

interpretation_notes: All24 candidate/run combinations yielded eligible selected poses, with no exclusions or execution errors.
NU6102 recovered two Asp86 contacts across3declared seed pairs and crystal heavy-atom RMSD0.279–0.359A; a retrospective receptor-informed control, not general docking validation.

Methylsulfone has3/3 computed backbone-N acceptor contacts. Hydroxymethyl has3/3 computed contact-positive selections, with backbone acceptor contact robust across the separate OH rotation diagnostic.

Carboxamide and acetamide are contact-positive in2/3 seed runs. Contact-first selection can choose a pose with a less favorable Vina score; for acetamide seed2 it selects-8.125 over eligible noncontact-8.553.

Hydroxy0/3 is conditional on saved H orientation: a post-run fixed-heavy-atom uniform OH grid reveals another planar rotamer can satisfy the donor-angle rule at similar ligand-only MMFF energy. This diagnostic was never fed back as a prediction or counted as a hit.
Nitrile0/3 is not evidence of lack of biological activity. Its acceptor approaches Asp sidechain acceptors but remains4.23–4.27A from Asp backboneN in selected poses.
All inputs are declared neutral graphs. No pKa/state-population, affinity, synthesizeability, or wet-lab activity claim is made.

No stronger neural model, score threshold relaxation, or new receptor was justified by these results. Improve evidence about hydrogen placement before treating negative donor contacts as strong conclusions.

metadata_change.scope: Additive graph-derived hydrogen-preparation metadata only. No scientific coordinates, score, contact detector, selection, thresholds, target preparation or original artifacts changed.

metadata_change.new_OH_warning: OH presence is detected from explicit saved O-H-C connectivity. It warns orientation was not receptor-optimized or sensitivity-assessed; it does not claim this specific pose changes under a rotation.
metadata_change.protocol_version: guided_growth_cdk2_v2 revision2 retained because the scientific algorithm is unchanged; source implementation fingerprint explicitly changed and froze on each new submission.

declaration.purpose: Explicit metadata-only implementation validation; original inputs, seeds, scientific behavior, thresholds and history retained.

primary_equivalence.comparison: Exact equality of every saved primary pose field and viewer field excluding runtime and additive hydrogen-preparation metadata. Contact arrays are compared as exact sorted multisets, since ProLIF residue iteration can reorder them between processes; viewer contact enumeration IDs are omitted but endpoint IDs, distances, angles, types and all coordinates are exact. No floating-point tolerance or favorable-pose rematching. SDF content hashes can differ due writer timestamps, so audit separately validates SDF/view coordinate identity.
